topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I can't stop thinking about those flowers. They're sitting right there on the table, these beautiful, anonymous messengers. I mean, who sends flowers without a card? It's like they want to say something but don't want to actually say it. What if they're from someone who’s trying to be nice, but what if they’re from someone... well, you know. I keep looking at them, trying to guess from the kind of flowers or the color. Maybe I should just call the florist, find out who ordered them. Or maybe I’m overthinking this, but I can’t help it. What do you think I should do?
